# dela — minimalist puzzle game for iPhone and iPad

> dela is a minimalist iOS puzzle game about cutting abstract shapes into two perfectly balanced halves with as few straight lines as possible. 137 hand-tuned levels. Premium upfront: one price, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no accounts. Built by Erik Nielsen, an independent designer-engineer in Stockholm.

## What is dela?

dela ("divide" in Swedish) is a puzzle game built around a single mechanic: drag to cut a shape into two parts of equal area. The cut snaps to the grid. Fewer cuts is better. The mechanic is simple; the decisions are not.

The brand name is always lowercase: "dela", including at the start of sentences.

## Key facts

- **Levels:** 137 hand-tuned levels
- **Platform:** iOS (iPhone and iPad). Requires iOS 17.0 or later.
- **Price:** $2.99 (US), one-time purchase. No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no accounts.
- **Privacy:** fully offline. No server connection, no analytics or advertising SDKs in the app, no login. Progress is stored on the device only; deleting the app removes all data.
- **App Store:** https://apps.apple.com/app/dela-the-art-of-dividing/id6766864158
- **App Store ID:** 6766864158
- **Developer:** Erik Nielsen (solo indie developer, Stockholm, Sweden)
- **Website:** https://playdela.com
